mechanics.claim: Demonic Ascension's cooldown begins on cast, not on the buff ending.
During Demonic Ascension, Swain deals damage and heals himself every 0.5 seconds per enemy target affected.
mechanics.quote: drains the lifeforce of nearby enemies, both dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|healing}} himself every {{fd|0.5}} seconds per target affected

mechanics.claim: Demonic Ascension is lost (ends) once Demonic Energy is depleted to 0.
mechanics.quote: ''Demonic Ascension'' is lost once all {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}} is depleted to {{as|0|azakana}}.

mechanics.claim: Scoring a champion takedown fully restores Demonic Energy to 50, extending the buff's duration.
mechanics.quote: fully restores it to the maximum of {{as|50|azakana}} upon scoring a {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}

mechanics.claim: Demonflare is automatically cast when Demonic Ascension expires, unless Demonflare is itself on cooldown at that moment.
mechanics.quote: does so automatically when ''Demonic Ascension'' expires if ''{{ai|Demonflare|Swain}}'' is not on cooldown at the time of expiration

mechanics.claim: Demonflare will not auto-cast at the end of Demonic Ascension if the ability ends due to Swain's death.
mechanics.quote: will not automatically cast at the end of ''Demonic Ascension'' if it occurs due to '''Swain's''' {{tip|death}}

mechanics.claim: Demonflare counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects such as Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: ''Demonflare'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The heal from Demonic Ascension's drain is reduced by 90% against minions and monsters.
mechanics.quote: The heal is reduced by 90% against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
